verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs describe vendor invoices being routed, approved, and 'paid' automatically via a dedicated payment AI agent, implying built-in bill-pay/payment execution, but no evidence explicitly confirms domestic ACH or wire rail support, transfer limits, or same-day options. Missing for 10: explicit mention of ACH/wire payment methods, processing times, and any independent confirmation that payments are actually disbursed via bank rails rather than just approval routing.
